dateline: DAY 4372 — SEPTEMBER 2026 — GOVERNMENT PROMISES REPORT AHEAD OF 12TH ANNIVERSARY, FAMILIES CALL ADVANCES INSUFFICIENT
heroHeadline: Sheinbaum Promises Pre-Anniversary Report as Families Call Investigation Advances Insufficient
heroSubtitle: President Sheinbaum met families of the 43 for 3.5 hours on August 27, presenting four investigation lines — renewed phone-record analysis, new detentions, review of facts, and reevaluation of key actors — which families called insufficient, pressing for a stronger case against jailed former Governor Ángel Aguirre. Interior Secretary Rosa Icela Rodríguez said the government would release a joint Segob–FGR progress report before the September 26 anniversary; as of mid-September it had not appeared. The period was marked by grief as well as politics: Francisco Rodríguez Morales, father of disappeared student Everardo Rodríguez Bello, died August 21 without answers, becoming one of at least seven parents of the 43 to die awaiting the truth. Families held the 143rd monthly Global Action on August 26, and normalistas seized buses on September 13 to launch a 'Jornada de Lucha' running through the 12th anniversary on September 26–27.
footerNote: Data compiled from GIEI reports (I–VI), Mexican Truth Commission, CNDH Recommendation 208VG/2026, EAAF forensic reports, IACHR/OHCHR statements, and investigative journalism (Proceso, Infobae, La Jornada, Tlachinollan). All contested claims are marked.
